preconditions: The shared I2C bus must already be initialized.
Any touch reset line must be released before probe.
steps: Read an identification or status register if available.
Configure any board-local interrupt GPIO after successful probe.

validationHooks.description: Confirm the controller acknowledges on I2C.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The touch controller acknowledges on the configured I2C address.
failureNotes: No I2C response usually indicates a power, reset, or address mismatch.

validationHooks.description: Sample the interrupt line state without requiring a touch event.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The interrupt line can be sampled through the board mapping.
failureNotes: A quiet interrupt line is not a fault by itself.

checks: Confirm the controller acknowledges on I2C.
Sample the interrupt line state without requiring a touch event.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The controller responds on I2C and the interrupt line can be sampled.
failureNotes: A quiet interrupt line is not a fault by itself.
No I2C response usually indicates a power, reset, or address mismatch.

highLevel.name: touch_is_present
highLevel.description: Return whether the controller responded during setup.

highLevel.name: touch_read_points
highLevel.description: Read the current touch points from the controller.

highLevel.name: touch_irq_active
highLevel.description: Read the board-mapped interrupt state for event-driven input.
